lines.text: Harper walks out of the hospital into the freezing Boston air, her 17-year-old sister Mia trailing behind her in a hospital sling.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: We are taking a cab, Mia. I'm done with the Whitmore family and their billionaire games.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: But Harper, what about Cole? He paid for my heart surgery, even if he lied about being a mechanic.
Jake Whitmore steps out of a sleek black sedan, blocking their path with a predatory grin.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Looking for a ride, Harper? My 29-year-old half-brother Cole is a fraud, but my corporate offer is entirely real.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Stay away from us, Jake, or I will call the police right now.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Sign my papers and I will protect you from Diane, who murdered our grandmother Evelyn just to seize board control.
Cole smashes a wrench against a workbench, furious that his 32-year-old billionaire identity ruined his marriage to Harper.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Diane killed my grandmother Evelyn, and I am going to prove it before it destroys everything I love.
COLE picks up a hidden security flash drive containing the hospital footage from the night of Evelyn's fatal seizure.
A masked figure lunges from the shadows, plunging a heavy metal pipe directly into Cole's chest.
